bullet_points: Load the 10 realizations of galaxy and halo catalogs.
Compute $R_{vir}$ for each halo from $M_{vir}$ assuming mean matter density at $z=0$.
Create a lookup table mapping every satellite to its parent halo's center and $R_{vir}$ using spatial proximity and the `ln_M_h` field.
Print summary statistics (number of satellites matched, fraction unmatched, mean satellites per halo) to validate association quality.
Save the processed association data to disk.
Calculate $\xi_{hh}(r)$ and $\xi_{gh}(r)$ using a Landy-Szalay estimator with a random catalog of the same volume.
Compute bias $b(M)$ in 3 logarithmically spaced mass bins above $M_{sat} = 10^{13} M_\odot/h$.
Print per-bin bias values and their variance across the 10 realizations.
Save the bias estimates and correlation functions to disk.
Compute 3D $P(k)$ for galaxies and halos using a $256^3$ CIC grid.
Subtract shot noise ($1/\bar{n}$) from both spectra.
Compare $P_{hh}(k)$ against theoretical $P_{lin}(k)$ scaled by halo bias.
Print the $k$-range where galaxy $P(k)$ exceeds shot noise by a factor of 2.
Create "shuffled" catalogs by randomizing satellite angular positions while keeping centrals fixed at halo centers and preserving radial distances.
Perform a KS-test comparing radial distance distributions before and after shuffling to confirm correctness.
Save the shuffled catalogs to disk.
Compute marked correlation $M(r)$ using luminosity relative to the mean luminosity of galaxies in the same halo mass bin.
Compare $M(r)$ for original vs. shuffled catalogs in the 1-halo regime ($r < 5$ Mpc/h).
Produce a plot comparing $M(r)$ with error bands from the 10 realizations.
Decompose the 2PCF into central-satellite, satellite-satellite, and central-central pair contributions using the `is_central` flag and association table.
Produce a plot showing each contribution separately across the full $r$ range.
Calculate empirical 3D radial density profiles $\rho(r)$ for satellites in 3 mass bins above $M_{sat}$.
Fit an exponential profile $\exp(-r/r_{scale})$ to each bin and report $r_{scale}/R_{vir}$ with bootstrap uncertainties.
Generate a multi-panel figure showing radial profiles per mass bin vs. theoretical predictions.
Aggregate all bias, power spectrum, and correlation metrics across realizations.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Radial Profile Diagnostic and Statistical Aggregation

bullet_points: Synthesize results to define the "Reliability Threshold" for the dataset.
Document the range of scales ($r > r_{limit}$) and specific statistics where the catalog is robust for cosmological inference.
Write the full Results section of the report, interpreting all plots and statistics, and discussing the validity of the HOD spatial implementation.
